title: sopack propose output (v1)
description: The JSON `sopack propose <source> --json` prints to stdout (SOPACK-1.0-PLAN.md §3.5, §6). Produced by crates/sopack-extract/src/propose.rs (`Proposal`) — keep the two in sync. `propose` never fills a field's `value` unless every candidate for it agrees AND at least one candidate's `from` is `title_page`, `sop_json_meta` or `sop_json_dir` (see propose.rs's `is_authoritative`) — every other field stays `null` and is listed in `unresolved`.

value.description: null unless every candidate agrees and at least one is authoritative (see this schema's top-level description).

from.description: A short, stable source tag, e.g. title_page, opf:dc:title, opf:dc:date, opf:dc:source, opf:dc:source_normalized, opf:dc:rights, opf:dc:rights_normalized, opf:dc:language, filename, filename_normalized, lang_heuristic, title_heuristic, title_heuristic_alt, author_heuristic, front_matter, first_lines, sop_json_meta, sop_json_dir, sop_json_key_guess, derived:book_code, registry:title_match (re-import detector: the title matched an existing registry row by title, not by code — see Registry::find_by_title).

collision.description: Only ever present on a book_code candidate: whether the literal code string is already a row in the offline registry. Absent (not just null) when no registry was given.
